rationale: The plan correctly treats the two-time-point design as a 2x2 factorial with ~condition*time, tests the condition:time interaction by Wald as the primary answer, and reports simple effects at each time with ashr shrinkage, matching the reference. QC (blind VST, PCA, distance heatmap, library sizes, explicit flag-not-drop policy), a group-size-justified low count filter, in-model median-of-ratios normalization, BH at 0.05 with independent filtering, and a full report spec are all explicitly stated. Reference levels are required but not named concretely, and time is only implicitly treated as a factor via reference-level setting. Enrichment was not requested; the added ORA is well specified (tested-gene universe, named collections with versions, 15-500 size window, per-contrast lists) but the odd justification for rejecting GSEA and the unrequested scope keep that criterion from full marks.
